title: Schedule of Cancellation and Refund Terms — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited
content:
# Marlowe & Finch Unlimited: cancellation and refund terms by plan

Finance schedule of the terms on which a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership is cancelled and its fee refunded.

## Terms that differ by plan

| Plan | Refund on a cancellation after the full-refund window |
|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | None — the cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period |
| Unlimited Student Annual | Unused full calendar months of the period, less the benefit value used |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | Unused full calendar months of the period, less the benefit value used |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | None — the cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period |
| Unlimited Express Annual | Unused full calendar months of the period, less the benefit value used |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | Unused full calendar months of the period, less the benefit value used |

## Terms common to every plan

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Member must personally confirm a cancellation | Yes |
| When a cancellation without refund takes effect | At the end of the current period |
| Benefits until a scheduled cancellation takes effect | Yes |
| Full-refund window after a fee charge, with no benefit used since that charge | 14 calendar days |
| Date every refund window counts from | The latest fee charge date |
| Lowest prorated refund paid | 0.00 USD |
| Rounding of computed refunds | Half up to the cent |
| Where fee refunds go | The card the fee was charged to |

## Notes

- The plans whose refund basis is "none" are the two monthly plans; the four annual plans carry the prorated basis of unused full calendar months less the benefit value used.
- A refund floor of 0.00 means a prorated refund is never negative: where the benefit value used exceeds the unused share of the fee, the refund paid is 0.00.
- Rounding half up to the cent: a computed refund of a hypothetical 12.345 is paid as 12.35, and one of 12.344 as 12.34.
